name: shieldedscan
description: A privacy-first Zcash block explorer: shielded pools, cross-chain flows and network analytics.

scripts.verify: npm run format:check && npm run check && npm test && npm run build
scripts.dev:agent-demo: node scripts/bundle.mjs server/agent/testing/demo-server.ts dist/agent-demo.mjs && node dist/agent-demo.mjs
scripts.build:judge: node scripts/bundle.mjs server/agent/evals/judge-validate.ts dist/eval-judge-validate.mjs && node scripts/bundle.mjs server/agent/evals/judge-review.ts dist/eval-judge-review.mjs
scripts.rollups:explain: node scripts/bundle.mjs server/explain-rollups-main.ts dist/explain-rollups.mjs && node --env-file-if-exists=.env.local dist/explain-rollups.mjs
scripts.rollups:fill: node scripts/bundle.mjs server/fill-rollups-main.ts dist/fill-rollups.mjs && node --env-file-if-exists=.env.local dist/fill-rollups.mjs
scripts.rollups:check: node scripts/bundle.mjs server/check-rollups-main.ts dist/check-rollups.mjs && node --env-file-if-exists=.env.local dist/check-rollups.mjs
scripts.rollups:swap: node scripts/bundle.mjs server/swap-rollups-main.ts dist/swap-rollups.mjs && node --env-file-if-exists=.env.local dist/swap-rollups.mjs
